en: A black and white photograph showing a large industrial factory complex surrounded by trees and hills. The buildings are arranged closely together, with a prominent smokestack rising from the center. The foreground features a grassy field, and the whole scene appears calm and rural. The top of the postcard includes the text 'MONTLUEL — Vue générale de l'Usine Heer,' indicating a general view of the Heer factory in Montluel.
